page.jesus.title: JESUS
page.jesus.subtitle: Get To Know Jesus
page.jesus.intro: Jesus Christ is the Son of God. He came into the world to show us the love of the Father, gave His life on the cross for our sins and rose again on the third day. Through Him, everyone can know God personally.
page.jesus.who.text1: The Bible tells us that Jesus is fully God and fully man. He healed the sick, set people free and taught about the Kingdom of God.
page.jesus.who.text2: He died in our place and rose from the dead, defeating sin and death. Jesus is alive today, and He still changes lives.
page.jesus.salvation.text1: Salvation is a free gift from God. You cannot earn it; you receive it by faith. The Bible says: “If you declare with your mouth, ‘Jesus is Lord,’ and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.” (Romans 10:9)
page.jesus.salvation.text2: If you want to receive Jesus today, you can pray this prayer: “Lord Jesus, I believe that You are the Son of God, that You died for my sins and rose again. I turn away from my sins and invite You into my life as my Lord and Saviour. Thank You for forgiving me and making me new. Amen.”
page.jesus.salvation.text3: Did you pray this prayer? We would love to hear from you, pray with you and help you take your next steps.
page.about.title: About Us
page.about.subtitle: Glorious Church Nederland
page.about.intro: Glorious Church Nederland (TGC Netherlands) is part of The Glorious Church, the worldwide church founded by Prophet Jerome Fernando.
page.about.text1: Every month we meet online on ZOOM to worship together, hear the Word of God and pray for one another. Whether you live in the Netherlands or are just visiting, you are very welcome.
page.about.text2: Our vision is to impact, influence and inspire the nations through the integrity of the Word of God, confirmed by signs, wonders, miracles and prophetic exploits.
page.believe.title: What We Believe
page.believe.subtitle: Our Statement of Faith
page.believe.intro: These are the core beliefs that shape our church and everything we do.
page.believe.bible.title: The Bible
page.believe.bible.text: We believe the Bible is the inspired Word of God, true and trustworthy, and our guide for faith and life.
page.believe.god.title: One God
page.believe.god.text: We believe in one God, eternally existing as Father, Son and Holy Spirit.
page.believe.jesus.title: Jesus Christ
page.believe.jesus.text: We believe Jesus Christ is the Son of God. He died on the cross for our sins, rose from the dead and is coming again.
page.believe.spirit.title: The Holy Spirit
page.believe.spirit.text: We believe the Holy Spirit lives in every believer, empowers us to live for God and still works today through signs, wonders, miracles and the gifts of the Spirit.
page.believe.salvation.title: Salvation
page.believe.salvation.text: We believe salvation is a free gift of God’s grace, received by faith in Jesus Christ.
page.believe.church.title: The Church
page.believe.church.text: We believe the church is the family of God, called to worship Him, grow in His Word and share the good news with the nations.
page.prophet.title: Prophet Jerome Fernando
page.prophet.subtitle: Prophet Jerome's Story
page.prophet.intro: Prophet Jerome Fernando is the founder of The Glorious Church and Prophet Jerome Fernando Ministries.
page.prophet.text1: He is known for his passion for the Word of God and for a prophetic ministry marked by signs, wonders and miracles. Through his ministry, people in many nations have come to faith in Jesus.
page.prophet.text2: Visit the ministry’s website to learn more about his story, his teaching and the work of the ministry around the world.
page.faq.title: FAQ's
page.faq.subtitle: Frequently Asked Questions
page.faq.intro: Answers to the questions we are asked most often. Can’t find your answer? Get in touch.
page.faq.q1: How do I join a ZOOM meet up?
page.faq.a1: Go to the Meetings page, find the next meet up and click its poster or the “Join on ZOOM” button. You can join from your computer, tablet or phone.
page.faq.q2: Do I need to be a member to join?
page.faq.a2: No. Everyone is welcome, whether you are new to faith or have followed Jesus for years.
page.faq.a3: No. Our meet ups are free to join.
page.faq.q4: I need prayer. Who can I contact?
page.faq.a4: You can call the Faithline or send us an email. You will find both on the Contact page.
page.faq.q5: Is there a Glorious Church in other countries?
page.faq.a5: Yes. The Glorious Church gathers in many nations. Use “Find A Church Near You” to find one.
page.testimonies.title: Testimonies
page.testimonies.subtitle: What God Has Done
page.testimonies.intro: God is still doing miracles today. Here we share stories of healing, breakthrough and changed lives from our church family.
page.testimonies.text1: Testimonies from TGC Netherlands will be shared here soon.
page.testimonies.text2: Has God done something in your life? We would love to hear your story and give God the glory together.
page.serve.title: Want to Serve?
page.serve.subtitle: Serve With Us
page.serve.intro: Church is a family, and every member has a part to play. Would you like to use your gifts to serve God and others?
page.serve.text1: There are many ways to help: welcoming people at our ZOOM meet ups, prayer, worship, media, or helping to organise events in the Netherlands.
page.serve.text2: Let us know how you would like to serve and we will get in touch with you.
page.find.title: Find A Church Near You
page.find.subtitle: Local, Global & Online
page.find.intro: Wherever you are, there is a place for you in the Glorious Church family.
page.find.local.text: In the Netherlands we currently meet online every month. Contact us to find out about gatherings near you.
page.find.global.text: The Glorious Church gathers in many nations around the world. Visit our global church website to find a church near you.
page.find.online.text: Join our monthly ZOOM meet ups from anywhere. See the dates and links on the Meetings page.
